what: Every run of the CRT purity checks, failures included. Bounds file unchanged since 679f718.

failures: identity: max deviation 1. A test bug: the test pattern wrote into the alpha channel and the comparison included alpha. Fixed to compare RGB.

degauss after 5 tau: landing error 0.00121 against 0.001. I had left the spatial gain (0.3 + r^2, up to 1.3) out of my estimate when choosing the amplitude 0.14. Amplitude lowered to 0.11 (preset choice).

runs.result: a white field showed grey blotches, not colour: with one shared landing error, each stripe receives its neighbour's light in exchange and only the black matrix takes light away
runs.change: Per-gun spread: gun k lands with e (1 + 0.35 (k - 1)), since the outer guns sit off-axis (a choice, low confidence). landing() now takes one error per gun; the purity test's call is unchanged in meaning. The 5-tau test now multiplies by the worst gun's factor (stricter); with it the amplitude 0.11 failed (0.0013), so the degauss amplitude is 0.08 (0.00095).

runs.check: node tests and GPU parity after the change
